notes: represents 4: Dark tile with a light grid pattern: doesn't show removing edges. -> Show a 2x2 quad patch with the middle edges dashed/fading in red and the merged face lit.
distinct 6: Different from cube icons, close to Topology grid. -> Use a grey cube surface instead of a flat tile.
legibility 5: At 1x a dark speckled tile. -> Bold light edges, red dissolving edge.
craft 6: Noisy pattern. -> Clean grid lines.
represents 5: Cream paper with a grey knob and red mark: setting a parameter is unclear. -> Replace with a large dial knob with tick marks and a red pointer, or a slider with a red handle.
distinct 7: Different from Remove bin and Remedy box. -> Keep away from cream paper used by Sketch/Topology.
legibility 5: At 1x it's a tiny cream square with specks. -> Fill the cell with the dial.
craft 6: Muddy small details on the paper. -> Remove the paper, one clean dial.

represents 6: Lumpy grey chain over a thin red line: body following curve is weakly suggested. -> Make a thicker smooth grey bar clearly bent along a bold red S curve with yellow control dots at the ends.
distinct 6: Overlaps Spline and Sweep in idea and look. -> Show a straight ghost bar plus the bent bar on the curve.
legibility 5: At 1x it's a thin squiggle, segments merge. -> Double the body thickness and the red curve width.
craft 6: Lumpy segments look messy. -> One smooth continuous body.

represents 6: Blue fabric patch with a thin yellow-edged strip at the top; the flap is barely visible and it reads as a label or plain patch. -> Sew a raised square pocket on the fabric with a clearly folded-over flap (darker blue, 3+ px tall) and a yellow button on the flap, red stitch line around the pocket edge.
distinct 6: Flat blue patch looks like Fabric and Wear on the same sheet. -> Give the pocket visible thickness and a shadow so it stands off the base cloth, unlike flat Fabric/Wear.
legibility 5: At 1x the flap is a 1-px yellow line and the pocket disappears into the patch. -> Enlarge the pocket to half the patch and make the flap edge a 2-px contrasting line.
craft 7: Clean outline, but the composition is mostly empty blue. -> Crop the base fabric smaller so the pocket fills the frame.

represents 6: Paper with a grey block on it and a red line along one edge; reads as a block on a sheet, not a 2D cross-section outline. -> Remove the grey block; draw a bold red closed L or T-shaped outline on the paper (flat 2D profile), optionally with a faint ghost extrusion above it.
distinct 5: Nearly the same paper composition as #2 Sketch. -> Drop the paper: stand the red profile outline upright on its own like a cutout, so it differs from Sketch.
legibility 6: At 1x it's a grey smudge on cream; the red outline is a thin sliver. -> Make the profile outline 2 px red and the shape large in the frame.
craft 7: Clean outline, some muddy red/grey overlap. -> Separate red outline from grey fill with clear spacing.

represents 6: Grey cube on one end, dark slider bar with yellow handle, pink sphere at the other: blend idea present but reads like a tool/rod. -> Make an obvious slider track (light rail) with a red handle mid-way, cube at the left stop and sphere at the right stop.
distinct 5: Same rod-and-sphere parts as Key end next to it. -> Keep shape key horizontal with handle centred; give Key end a different composition.
legibility 6: At 1x the handle is a few yellow px. -> Handle 3x4 px in red.
craft 7: Clean outlines. -> Lighten the track so it doesn't merge with the dark wheel.
represents 6: Pink oval with faint pale spots: details barely suggested. -> Add darker brown freckles (2x2 px), a few pore dots, and a small magnifying lens over part of the skin.
distinct 6: Pink oval resembles Blob and Sculpt pads. -> The lens and brown freckles make it unique; flatten to a square swatch.
legibility 5: At 1x the spots vanish, leaving a plain pink oval. -> High-contrast brown spots, at least 2x2 px each.
craft 7: Clean outline, spots look like smudges. -> Crisp-edged spots.
represents 6: Cream grid sheet with a red dot: looks like graph paper. -> Grey surface with a bold light quad wireframe and a red pole vertex/bad face highlighted.
distinct 6: Close to Dissolve tile and Paint maps sheet. -> Use grey mesh, not cream paper.
legibility 5: Grid lines vanish at 1x. -> 2-px grid lines, 3x3 cells.
craft 7: Clean. -> Stronger outline.
represents 5: Black top hat with a small texture card: reads as a magic hat. -> Replace with an oven box with heat glow emitting a texture-map tile.
distinct 7: Different from Render/Save. -> Keep away from Paint maps by colour.
legibility 6: Texture card tiny at 1x. -> Bigger card.
craft 7: Clean. -> Tidy the hat brim outline.

represents 6: Cube with a red slanted strip cut into the front: reads as a slot or mouth, not a bevelled edge. -> Replace the top-front edge with one narrow slanted red face running the full edge length; no notch.
distinct 6: Close to Loop cut (red line on cube) and Chamfer/Fillet. -> Make the bevel clearly on an edge, two-segment strip, so it differs from Loop cut.
legibility 6: Red is visible at 1x but the shape is ambiguous. -> Bigger bevel width (3+ px).
craft 6: Ragged dark gap under the red strip. -> Clean continuous faces.

represents 5: Stack of stepped grey tiers with a red disc on top: reads as a stepped pyramid/cake, no blend between different sections. -> Show a square red profile at the base and a round red profile at the top with one smooth skin blending square-to-round between them; remove the steps.
distinct 6: Close to Extrude (block on plate) and Draft (tapered). -> The square-to-circle smooth transition makes it unique; drop the base plate.
legibility 7: Silhouette clear at 1x, red top visible. -> Keep two red profiles strongly visible at each end.
craft 7: Clean outlines; steps look busy. -> Smooth single surface removes the clutter.
represents 7: Red mirror plane with a grey object on one side. -> Show one solid half and a matching red-outline copy on the other side with an arrow across the plane.
distinct 5: Red plane plus grey shape is the same idea as Mirror and close to Symmetry check. -> Use a mesh cube half with visible vertices/edges, so it's mesh-specific, not Mirror.
legibility 6: At 1x a muddle of red and grey. -> Plane edge-on vertical line, halves clearly separated.
craft 6: Grey shape is lumpy and unclear. -> Simple clean shape.
represents 6: Grey cube, red dot, cream block: file not clear. -> Make the target a paper file with folded corner and a red arrow pointing outward from the cube.
distinct 5: Near mirror of Import. -> Arrow points out and right; Import should point in.
legibility 7: Arrow reads as a dot at 1x. -> 3-px arrowhead.
craft 7: Clean. -> Overlap parts slightly.
represents 6: Cream block, red arrow, grey cube: cream block doesn't read as a file. -> Make the source a paper sheet with a folded corner (file), red arrow pointing INTO the grey cube.
distinct 5: Near mirror of #34 Export (cube, red dot, cream block). -> Change layout: file on top dropping down into an open box/tray, arrow pointing down, so it can't be confused with Export.
legibility 7: Three parts read at 1x but the arrow is a red dot, direction unclear. -> Make a proper red arrow with a 3-px head showing direction.
craft 7: Clean outlines, pieces floating loosely. -> Tighten the composition and overlap the parts slightly.

represents 6: Dark rod ending in a yellow collar and a red ring around a pink ball: reads as a magnifier/lollipop, not a slider end stop. -> Show the slider track ending in a red end-bracket with the handle docked against it and the target shape (sphere) beyond.
distinct 5: Shares rod + pink sphere with Shape key. -> Remove the rod-ball look; use the bracket stop as the dominant shape.
legibility 7: Ring reads at 1x. -> Make the stop bracket 3 px thick red.
craft 7: Clean. -> Shorten the thin dark rod that blends into the background.

represents 6: Grey slab sitting on a red plane: the cut and the kept side aren't clear. -> Show a block sliced by a red plane through its middle, top half kept, bottom half shown as a faint ghost or falling away.
distinct 6: Close to Plane (grey sheet) and Section (red cut face). -> Show the discarded half separated to distinguish from Section.
legibility 6: At 1x a grey lump on a red smear. -> Larger block, crisp red plane edge.
craft 7: Red plane is a bit muddy/dithered. -> Flat red plane with clean outline.

represents 6: Red truncated pyramid with a dark tip: reads as a pyramid/cone, not a draft angle on walls. -> Grey block body with only its side walls slanted in red, plus a vertical dashed reference line and a small angle arc next to one wall.
distinct 6: Similar to Push face's dark spike and Loft's tapered stack. -> Remove the dark spike; the angle arc and reference line make it unique.
legibility 7: Red shape reads at 1x; the meaning doesn't. -> Angle arc in yellow, 2 px.
craft 7: Clean, dark tip looks stray. -> Remove the dark tip.

represents 7: Cream paper with dark scribble lines and a yellow pencil: drawing on paper reads. -> Draw one bold red closed shape (rectangle or circle) on the paper instead of thin scribbles, pencil tip touching it.
distinct 6: Same paper-on-table setup as #3 Profile next to it. -> Make the pencil much larger and diagonal across the sheet so pencil is the key part, unlike Profile.
legibility 6: At 1x the lines and pencil are 1-px thin and blur into the paper. -> Thicken the pencil to 3+ px and the drawn stroke to 2 px red.
craft 7: Clean outline, but small and lots of empty frame. -> Scale the paper up to fill the cell.

represents 7: Curved grey tube with a red ring end and thin red path line: sweep along path reads. -> Make the red path a bold rail running the full length and extending ahead of the tube, with the red profile ring at the leading end.
distinct 6: Grey curved tube resembles Bend (#15) arc. -> Make the path S-shaped and visible beyond the tube end so it isn't just a bent bar.
legibility 6: At 1x the tube is small and the path is 1 px. -> Scale the tube up and thicken the red path to 2 px.
craft 7: Clean, slightly empty frame. -> Fill the cell more.

represents 7: Blue fabric with a dark heart-shaped hole and a tiny red dot: a hole reads, fray/scuff not. -> Make the hole ragged with 3-4 frayed thread ends sticking out, red rim on the torn edge, and a lighter scuff patch on the corner.
distinct 7: The hole separates it from Fabric/Pocket, though the base patch is the same. -> Tear a corner of the patch off too so the silhouette itself differs.
legibility 6: At 1x the hole is a small dark smudge; red dot is 1 px. -> Enlarge the hole to a third of the patch and make the red rim 2 px.
craft 7: Clean outline; heart-shaped hole looks cute rather than worn. -> Make the hole an irregular jagged shape.
represents 7: Grey cube with a red crack and a yellow wrench: repair reads. -> Make the wrench bigger, crossing the cube, and show the crack half-patched.
distinct 7: Differs from Remedy's first-aid box. -> Keep grey mesh cube.
legibility 7: Wrench thin at 1x. -> Wrench 3 px thick.
craft 7: Clean. -> Tidy the wrench outline.
represents 7: Pink block with a bite cut showing red interior: flesh reads, layering weak. -> Show distinct layers in the cut: thin pink skin, yellow fat band, red muscle core.
distinct 7: Different from Material sphere and Face material cube; pink like Skin. -> Keep the block shape; the layered cut separates it from Skin's flat oval.
legibility 7: At 1x the red cut reads as a notch. -> Make the cut deeper and wider, a quarter wedge removed.
craft 7: Clean outline, red interior a bit muddy. -> Flat colour bands instead of dither in the cut.
represents 7: Pink soft pad with a small tool tip poking it. -> Larger sculpt brush/loop tool and a clear raised bump or dent under it.
distinct 8: Unique on the Deform sheet. -> Keep pink clay; add red accent on the dent.
legibility 6: At 1x the tool is a few pixels; looks like a pink dish. -> Tool at least a third of the icon height.
craft 7: Clean outline, flat pad lacks form. -> Add shading to show the surface deformation.

represents 7: Bone with a pink flesh blob on its middle and a red up arrow: flesh around a bone reads. -> Wrap the flesh along most of the bone length as a capsule with bone ends sticking out, red arrows pointing outward from the bone.
distinct 7: Bone ends differ from Primitive/Part; close cousin of Bind on Rig sheet. -> Make flesh larger relative to bone so it reads as a body, not a bone with a marker.
legibility 7: Readable at 1x; the red arrow is small. -> Bigger red arrows (2) growing outward.
craft 8: Clean outline and shading. -> Minor: trim the single-px arrow shaft to 2 px.
represents 7: Pink limb bent at a joint: flexing reads. -> Add a red curved arrow around the joint.
distinct 8: Different from Corrective. -> Keep the thin limb.
legibility 7: Thin limb at 1x. -> Thicken the limb by 2 px.
craft 7: Clean. -> Smooth the elbow outline.
represents 8: Ring of grey cylinders around a red circle: circular pattern reads. -> Add a red curved arrow around the ring to show repetition around the circle.
distinct 7: Uses the same cylinders as Row pattern next to it; layout differs. -> Use a different instance shape (small cubes) or make the red circle bolder.
legibility 7: At 1x eight cylinders crowd into a blob. -> Use 6 larger copies with gaps between.
craft 7: Busy overlapping outlines. -> Fewer copies, cleaner gaps.
represents 8: Cube with a big red X over it. -> Show highlighted selected verts/edges with the X over them.
distinct 6: Close to Delete face (cube with red face). -> Show elements missing (a gap) with the X, distinct from the single red face.
legibility 8: X reads at 1x. -> Minor: bolder X.
craft 7: X overlaps the outline messily. -> Clean X over the cube.
represents 8: Blue butterfly with a red centre line: symmetric sides read. -> Add a small green/yellow check mark to show it's a check.
distinct 7: Red line across a shape echoes Clearance and Symmetrize. -> Make the red line a vertical dashed axis.
legibility 7: Wings blur slightly at 1x. -> Larger wings with a clear notch at the centre.
craft 7: Clean. -> Even out wing shapes exactly.
represents 8: Speech/note bubble with text lines next to a cube. -> Enlarge the bubble and add a tail pointing at the cube.
distinct 8: Different from Match. -> Keep bubble.
legibility 7: Text lines blur at 1x. -> Three 2-px lines.
craft 7: Clean. -> Tidy the bubble edge.
represents 8: Red S-curve with yellow end points and black tangent handles: a spline. -> Add a yellow control point in the middle of the curve with its handle, so 'through control points' reads.
distinct 8: Unique on the Form sheet; nearest is Curve (#16) on Deform. -> Keep the bare curve with no body attached to stay distinct from Curve.
legibility 7: Curve reads at 1x but the black handle lines vanish into the dark wheel. -> Make handles light grey 1-px lines with 2x2 yellow dots at their ends.
craft 7: Clean curve, handle lines look like stray black pixels. -> Recolour handles so they don't read as noise.
represents 8: Grey box with a red rounded edge band: rounded edge reads. -> Show the round as a clear quarter-circle profile on the side face so the radius is obvious.
distinct 7: Box-with-red-edge setup similar to Chamfer, but rounded vs triangular. -> Make the rounded edge larger radius so it contrasts with Chamfer's flat cut.
legibility 8: Red rounded top reads at 1x. -> Minor: brighten the highlight on the round.
craft 8: Clean. -> Reduce dither on grey faces.
represents 8: Grey bar bent into an arch with a red curved arrow above. -> Add a faint straight ghost bar to show before/after.
distinct 7: Arch resembles Sweep's curved tube. -> Make it a square-section bar to differ from Sweep's round tube.
legibility 8: Reads at 1x. -> Bigger arrowhead.
craft 8: Clean. -> Minor dither cleanup.
represents 8: Pink skin base with dense yellow strands growing up: fur reads. -> Use fewer, longer strands that curve and lean in one direction like groomed hair.
distinct 9: Nothing else on the Cloth sheet has strands. -> Keep the strands; recolour the base to blue fabric-free pink so it stays separate.
legibility 7: At 1x the strands merge into a yellow block like a brush. -> Thicken each strand to 2 px with 1-px gaps; 6-8 strands total.
craft 7: Busy jagged strand tops, slightly noisy. -> Taper each strand to a clean point.

represents 8: Two pink spheres overlapping into one organic lump; the melt is implied but the join is a hard crease, not a smooth neck. -> Add a visible smooth blend neck (filleted waist) between the two spheres so they clearly melt together, and add a third smaller sphere fused on.
distinct 8: Pink and organic, unlike the grey hard-edged Primitive; only other pink icons are on other sheets. -> Keep pink; add a small red highlight band at the blend neck to mark the melt action.
legibility 8: Silhouette reads at 1x as a double sphere; no red accent marks the action. -> Add a red accent on the blend seam so the action reads at 1x.
craft 8: Clean outline and shading, slight dithering on the shadow side. -> Reduce dither noise on the darker sphere and keep one clean shading ramp.
represents 9: Three-axis gizmo with red, yellow and blue arrows. -> Add a small rotation ring to cover rotate.
distinct 9: Nothing else on the sheet looks like a gizmo. -> Keep.
legibility 7: At 1x the blue arrow is dark against the wheel and the centre is tiny. -> Brighten blue arrow, bigger arrowheads and centre cube.
craft 8: Clean. -> Even out arrow lengths.
